item.title: 17 Aug — Make our short‑horizon markets unbreakable
item.description:
## The one thing If the window is thin, we use it: let’s harden our short‑horizon markets. Move our crypto 5–60m and in‑play micro‑markets to resolve on a short time‑weighted average price (TWAP) instead of a single snapshot, and add simple circuit rails (brief halts + quote/size guards). This removes the single‑tick exploit path and makes maker inventory viable.
